description: Grand Theft Auto 6 will be available to pre-load on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 10 at midnight. On PS5, the game can be pre-loading starting midnight local time, while on Xbox Series S/X, pre-loading will start at 12am GMT globally. Here's how you can pre-load the open world crime title ahead of launch.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Pre-Loading Begins November 10: How to Pre-Load on PS5, Xbox Series S/X

description: A fresh leak suggests that HMD will diversify its portfolio soon. The Finnish company is said to launch portable fans, pocket Wi-Fi devices, TWS earphones, smartwatches and power banks. HMD could also launch accessories such as smart plugs and data cables to enter the smart home accessories market. The new products could launch in 2027.
title: HMD Reportedly Planning to Expand Its Product Ecosystem Beyond Smartphones in 2027

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition Sale is now live in India. The ongoing sale offers up to 65 percent off on select projector models from brands such as BenQ, XGIMI, WZATCO, Lumio and E GATE. Buyers can also avail of additional savings through eligible bank offers, exchange deals and No Cost EMI options.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition Sale: Best Deals on Projectors From BenQ, XGIMI, WZATCO and More

description: Vivo's latest budget 5G smartphone brings a high-refresh-rate display and a large battery to the entry-level segment. The Y6k is equipped with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, 6GB of RAM and 128GB of onboard storage. It also offers a 13-megapixel rear camera, a 5-megapixel selfie shooter and 15W charging. Other features include an IP65 rating, SGS five-star drop-resistance certification, a side-mounted fingerprint sensor and an infrared blaster. The handset runs OriginOS 6 based on Android 16.
title: Vivo Y6k Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 6300 Chipset, 6,500mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Apple is reportedly working on changes that could prevent apps from appearing in the Full Disk Access settings after attempting to open restricted files. The current system lets developers direct users to this section to grant the required permission. The proposed change could remove this shortcut, although another method of enabling access may remain. Apple is also reportedly exploring Private Folders, which could let users share access to specific folders or databases without exposing all the data stored on their Macs.
title: macOS 27.3 May Tighten Full Disk Access Permissions to Protect Mac Users' Data

description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max are heading to international markets after their China debut in September. Both models feature secondary AMOLED screens on the rear, alongside large 120Hz displays with a Privacy Display feature. The camera setup includes two 200-megapixel sensors and a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera. Xiaomi has also equipped the phones with Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series processors, batteries of up to 8,500mAh and support for 100W wired charging.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Global Launch Date Announced; Back Display, Leica-Backed 200-Megapixel Cameras Teased

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition Sale is currently live, offering discounts on headphones and TWS. You can get your hands on the Spigen SA-HP P10 Over-Ear Headphones at a discounted price of Rs. 2,374, coming down from its listed price of Rs. 5,899. Similarly, the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds with ANC are listed at a relatively low price of Rs. 8,999, down from their listed price of Rs. 16,900, marking a price drop of about Rs. 8,000. Flagship earphones and headphones from Sony are also available during the Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition Sale. Apart from direct price cuts, the e-commerce giant is also offering an instant discount of 10 percent, up to Rs. 8,000, with Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, IDFC First Bank, and RBL Bank credit and debit cards. You can also avail a cashback of Rs. 150 on your first order, a 10 percent cashback on EMI transactions, or unlimited cashback of 5 percent with the Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit card.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Diwali Edition Sale: Best Deals on Headphones and TWS

description: Oppo Reno 17 will sport a similar design to its predecessor, the company revealed on Monday. The phone is shown to feature a similar design to this year’s Oppo Reno 16. However, the highlight design change is the addition of a holographic cat-like design element on the handset’s back. Moreover, the Oppo Reno 17 listing on the Oppo online store in the country has been updated to confirm that it will go on sale in three colour options, namely Cocoa Brown, Encounter with the Cat, and Ice Moon White (translated from Chinese). Separately, the company has also confirmed various specifications and features of the Oppo Watch 5 and Oppo Pad Air 6, along with their design.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Design, Colour Options Revealed Along With Oppo Pad Air 6, Watch 5 Features Ahead of China Launch

description: Reliance Jio's new Rs. 10,000 prepaid recharge comes with 1,095 days of validity and a total of 2,737.5GB of high-speed data. Subscribers also get unlimited voice calls, 100 SMS messages per day and unlimited 5G data, subject to eligibility and network coverage. The bundled benefits include a JioHotstar Mobile + Hollywood subscription, JioTV access and 50GB of JioAICloud storage. The plan also includes Canva Pro Lite for 12 months and is available through Jio's online and offline recharge channels.
title: Jio Launches Rs. 10,000 Prepaid Plan in India With 3-Year Validity and 2.5GB Daily Data

description: The price tags of the soon-to-be announced Vivo X500 series have leaked. The handsets have been launched in China, but are expected to be launched in India this month, as Vivo has already started putting up teasers for the same on its official social media channels.
title: Vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max Prices Leaked Ahead of India Launch

description: Oppo Pad 6F tablet has been listed on the BIS certification database with the model number OPD2605. While the BIS database does not reveal the tablet's commercial name or specifications, the appearance suggests that OPPO may be planning to bring the device to the country. The company launched the Oppo Pad 6 in May this year. The tablet has a 12.1-inch LCD screen with a 144Hz adaptive refresh rate. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 9500s processor.
title: Oppo Pad 6F Reportedly Spotted on BIS Certification Website, India Launch Could Be Imminent

description: WhatsApp's new Contacts tab brings saved contacts into a separate section of the Android app, with Favourites appearing at the top. Users can sort entries by name, birthday or activity, while a green indicator identifies people who are online. The section also includes a Meta AI shortcut, options to share invite links and a tool to add new contacts. The feature is currently reaching beta testers through the Google Play programme, with no confirmed date for a stable release.
title: WhatsApp Beta for Android Gets Dedicated Contacts Tab With New Features: Report

description: Samsung plans to launch a new Galaxy AI Premium subscription, according to a report. With the introduction, the company is said to offer two subscription tiers, namely Standard and Max. The Standard plan will reportedly offer similar benefits, usage limits, and features as those enjoyed by Galaxy smartphone owners. The standard Galaxy AI plan will be the free tier, offering AI-powered tools like Browsing Assist, Now Brief, Creative Studio, Smart Capture, Samsung Keyboard, Photo Assist, and Personal Agent. The plan will offer relatively low usage limits. Once exhausted, users will reportedly have to either purchase a credit pack or upgrade to the higher-end Max subscription tier.
title: Samsung Galaxy AI Premium Subscription to Launch With Higher Usage Limits and New AI Tools: Report

description: Airtel is reportedly offering a Buy 1 Get 1 Free deal on Rs. 349 and Rs. 399 prepaid plans. Multiple users have shared screenshots of the offer on X. Airtel's Rs. 349 and Rs. 399 prepaid plans offer 28 days' validity. With the latest offer, eligible users can avail 56 days' validity.  However, it appears that the telecom operator is extending the benefit to selected subscribers.
title: Airtel Reportedly Offering Buy 1 Get 1 Free Recharge Deal on Rs. 349 and Rs. 399 Prepaid Plans

description: A tipster has reiterated that the Vivo X500 Ultra could launch in March or April 2027, in line with the timeline previously indicated by a company executive. The phone is tipped to feature Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset for the upcoming flagship. Vivo has already hinted at better camera performance than the X500 Pro Max, while earlier leaks have suggested a 200-megapixel primary camera and a high-resolution periscope telephoto shooter.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Launch Timeline, Camera Specifications Tipped Again

description: Oppo Find X10 Ultra was expected to launch as a successor to the Find X9 Ultra. Now, development of the phone may have been suspended, according to a tipster. The flagship was tipped to feature three 200-megapixel cameras and a 6.89-inch 2K display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra was launched in India in May with a price tag of Rs. 1,69,999.
title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra Launch Uncertain as Tipster Claims Development Has Been Suspended

description: Meta’s Muse app is getting some upgrades with the ability to generate custom feeds, with custom AI-generated interfaces. Meta claims that these feeds can be used to keep track of ideas, to-do lists, as planners or even create simple trivia games with the data pulled into the feed.
title: Meta Introduces Spaces for Designing Custom Experiences Inside Muse AI App

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro will be launched in India in December, according to a report. The smartphone is set to be the first Pro model from the company to launch in the country in more than three years. The last Pro model to debut in India was the Xiaomi 13 Pro, which was unveiled in February 2023. The tech giant changed its product strategy for India in the following year, bringing only the standard and the top-of-the-line Ultra models to the country. Apart from this, the company is also reportedly preparing to launch the rumoured Xiaomi 18T, which might also arrive in India soon. In terms of specifications, the smartphone is said to sport an LTPS OLED display with 1.5K resolution and up to a 165Hz or 185Hz refresh rate. It could be powered by the unreleased octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 8600 chipset.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro India Launch Timeline, Xiaomi 18T Key Specifications and Features Surface Online

description: Xiaomi 18 has reportedly appeared on the 3C certification website with model number M261DB. The listing is believed to be associated with the standard Xiaomi 18 and indicates support for 100W wired fast charging. The Xiaomi 17 also supports 100W wired fast charging. The phone could launch in China in December.
title: Xiaomi 18 Reportedly Spotted on 3C Certification Website With 100W Fast Charging Support

description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in a message to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife and took "full responsibility" for his actions, while Nvidia said the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company without interruption. The developments are likely to pressure the chipmaker's stock, which has already fallen sharply amid worries about the AI boom's sustainability, and may also raise questions about Huang's future at the helm of the company he co-founded, analysts said.
title: Nvidia Probes Whether CEO Jensen Huang Was Target of Foreign Spying

description: The standard iPhone 18 is said to get a significant battery upgrade over its predecessor and the iPhone 18 Pro. The iPhone 18 is expected to come with a 6.3-inch display and an A20 chipset. It is tipped to feature a 48-megapixel primary rear camera and an 18-megapixel front-facing camera. It is said to come with a 4,430mAh battery. The iPhone 17 is believed to have a 3,692mAh battery.
title: iPhone 18 Tipped to Feature Bigger Battery Than iPhone 18 Pro; Other Key Specifications Leaked

description: Realme 17 Pro will be launched with the MediaTek Dimensity 7300 SoC, according to a report. The handset might sport an AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution and up to a 120Hz refresh rate. The Realme 17 Pro is expected to be equipped with a 10,000mAh battery. This claim is in line with earlier leaks, which suggested the same capacity battery for the handset. Moreover, the smartphone is said to launch with a dual rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel main shooter, paired with an 8-megapixel ultrawide camera. The phone will reportedly be capable of recording videos at up to 4K/30 fps. On the front, it could be equipped with a 32-megapixel or a 50-megapixel camera for selfies and video calls.
title: Realme 17 Pro Leak Reveals Full Specifications and Features List

description: Gentle Monster has shared a teaser for its upcoming Intelligent Eyewear collection, developed in collaboration with Samsung and Google. The clip features actor Joaquin Phoenix and offers a glimpse of an AI-powered translation feature. Directed by Jonathan Glazer, the campaign film will premiere in mid-November. The smart glasses will run on Google's Android XR platform and feature Gemini integration. Gentle Monster will open pre-orders in the US on November 12, ahead of the collection's scheduled December launch.
title: Gentle Monster Teases AI Smart Glasses With Gemini Integration Ahead of December Launch

description: A teardown of a new beta of the Gboard app has revealed new features coming to the virtual keyboard. These future feature upgrades are to do with Google’s Rambler feature, which is currently exclusive to Google’s Pixel 11 series of smartphones.
title: Gboard’s Rambler Feature Could Learn Your Vocabulary and Recognise Contact Names

description: Ubisoft is reportedly developing two unannounced Assassin's Creed projects, including one set in Ancient Rome. The game's setting could tie in with the Assassin's Creed Netflix TV series, which is set in 64 AD in Rome. The developer is reportedly also working on a mobile AC title, codenamed Pocket, which could be set in Jerusalem.
title: Two Unannounced Assassin's Creed Games Reportedly in Development, Codename Hexe Said to Be Delayed to 2028

description: Apple will launch the 20th anniversary iPhone next year without the Action Button, according to a tipster. Further, the leaker claims that the Action Button will be integrated into the Camera Control button. A single tap will reportedly open the camera, while a long press could trigger the assigned Action Button functionality, he added. Introduced with the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max in 2023, the Action Button has gone through little to no changes since its launch. It remains mappable to different “actions”, while being a mute switch by default. The Action Button replaced the Alert Slider, which allowed users to switch between modes. Started with the Pro models in 2023, the slider was phased out completely in 2024 with the arrival of the iPhone 16 lineup.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone to Launch Next Year Without an Action Button, Tipster Claims

description: Apple plans to turn Siri AI into an autonomous agent that will be able to take more actions on a user's behalf. The iPhone maker reportedly wants to bring similar capabilities to the AI assistant as OpenAI’s Dots, Meta’s Muse, and Grok from Elon Musk’s SpaceXSI. OpenAI, Meta, and AI labs position their respective AI agents as an “AI companion” that can run in the background and take actions for the user when required. Users can also hand over tasks, allowing the AI agents to do repetitive and monotonous tasks for the user. Apart from this, the report highlights that Apple has overhauled its development strategy for its next-generation iOS and iPadOS updates. The company has split its OS development into three stages, namely M1, M2, and M3, with each stage spanning eight weeks. The M1 stage is divided into two four-week sprints. However, the tech giant has reportedly asked its software engineers to code, explore, and develop features for six weeks for the iOS 28 update and to converge
title: Apple Plans to Bring Autonomous Capabilities to Siri AI, Overhaul iOS 28 Approach: Report
